claim.label: maturity
claim.sentence: Tower and nacelle inspection maturity SCALING

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: The same drone fleets that inspect blades increasingly cover towers and nacelles in the same visit, and offshore operators buy it to defer technician transfers. It is not yet universal practice because tower inspection is lower value per finding than blade inspection.
advance_criteria: Tower and nacelle coverage bundled by default in fleet inspection contracts
Standardised defect taxonomies accepted by certification bodies
Routine offshore use without vessel support
